text_block_list.name: Cafe Lady
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Bright-chan, having lunch late today, 
aren't you? Could you wait just a moment? 
All I can serve right away is ramen, so――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
One bowl of ramen, please. I was craving 
something savory after my self-training♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, how strange... No matter how much I 
eat, there's always more left~. ...*sigh*.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Lady
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, Bright-chan! Your noodles are 
getting completely soggy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright struggled to finish the 
bloated noodles, leaving her stomach 
feeling uncomfortably full...
